svg.title: Wes McKinney at Kenn Software
svg.desc: A 16-bit Wes McKinney floats in lotus pose, orbited by Kenn Software projects: AgentsView (what your agents did, and cost), roborev (continuous review for agent code), Ghosthub (one native Mac terminal for tmux), msgvault (a lifetime of email, searchable), Kenn Forge (triage, delegate, and review), kata (local issue ledger for agents), docbank (your document system of record), kwt (a worktree + tmux per branch), Fotobank (your photo library, agent-ready), BenchDB (catch perf regressions early).
svg.text: > agentic systems for what comes next. █
what your agents did, and cost
one native Mac terminal for tmux
$ open source · local-first · built for people and their agents
